text:
elliot: FYI noticed a reconnect storm after yesterday's edge keepalive tweak. Hundreds of sockets reconnected in a 10s window.
priya: ouch. which change exactly? the tcp keepalive interval drop to 15s?
joel: it was the proxy change: idle-probe shortened + aggressive halfclose detection to reclaim sockets. thought it would save CPU.
elliot: match timeline: deploy at 02:10Z, 02:13Z client SDKs started showing fast reconnects -> cascade.
priya: symptoms: users see duplicated events sometimes and billing shows increased token counts for short bursts.
joel: root cause theory: clients detect a socket close, immediately resume with session id and the resume route handler doesn't de-duplicate mid-flight resume requests when proxy chain is split. duplicate resume -> replay tokens counted twice.
elliot: reproducer: run 50 clients with staggered 200ms shutdowns, then force reconnect; you can see duplicate resume seqs in proxy logs: `resume_id=abc123 seq=1` appears twice within 50ms.
joel: we also saw the upstream health-checks causing simultaneous conn resets across shards. the new idle-probe triggered resets on pooled TLS sockets.
priya: two quick mitigations: 1) add server-side resume de-dupe window (idempotency cache for resume_id -> last_seen_ts) 2) on proxy change, ramp keepalive gradually instead of flip.
elliot: de-dupe window needs to be short (like 5s) but globally consistent per-tenant. otherwise we risk mem growth. suggestions for keying: `tenant:resume_id`.
joel: agree. also we should gate billing counters on `resume_ack` from model-workers, not just accept client replay as billable. that prevents double-charge on transient duplicates.
priya: console implications: current billing tile shows per-minute spikes and alerts ping on thresholds. we need a "suspected-replay" flag on telemetry so ops can silence noisy alerts during rollout.
elliot: telemetry plan: emit `stream.replay_suspected` with tags {route, shard, tenant, reason}. make it visible on the console as an overlay annotation on timeseries.
console-bot: feature request created: CF-STREAM-22 (show replay annotations on timeseries)
joel: rollout plan: revert keepalive change in prod ASAP, then deploy de-dupe + billing-gate to canary. perform 24h canary with synthetic reconnect load.
priya: also update client SDK to exponential backoff w/ jitter on resume attempts and a small random delay before resuming when detecting closure on pooled sockets.
elliot: SDK PR opened: rw-js#514, adds jitter and hints to avoid immediate resume storms.
joel: infra task: add a metric `proxy.resume_replays` and alert when rate > baseline * 3 for 5m. tie that alert to a playbook: rollback keepalive change.
priya: one more: console UX should allow ops to pin a rollout flag that auto-suppresses spike alerts for a given shard during rollout windows and annotate them. reduces pager noise.
elliot: agreed. I'll coordinate rollback and create the canary ticket. please post quick notes to CF-STREAM-22 and rw-js#514.
joel: I'll own server de-dupe and billing gating. will open ENG-STREAM-150.
priya: I'll handle SDK guidance + console suppress toggle.
infra-bot: rollback scheduled: edge-proxy/keepalive-config -> previous at 2026-03-21T15:45Z (initiated).
elliot: thanks. major lesson: pooled TLS + aggressive idle heuristics = amplified reconnect waves. need to test pooled socket behavior in staging before flipping.
priya: noted. adding a test plan item: simulate pooled TLS reset and measure resume idempotency under load.
console-bot: ticket CF-STREAM-22 updated with timeline and sample graph attachment.
elliot: good thread. will follow up with postmortem if spike persists.
_archive_note: generated slack thread about keepalive change causing reconnect storm, duplicate resume/billing, telemetry and console rollouts
